thread:
Sam: Heads-up — kicking off tenant_id type swap migration in the 02:00 UTC change window. Plan: apply DDL -> small canary -> quiesce region-by-region -> backfill with ratecap. Pin service API to v2.8.1 during the window.

deploy-bot: kickoff accepted (job=1751234567). Steps: apply-ddl -> canary-check -> quiesce -> backfill -> unpin. ETA DDL: ~15-25m; backfill: ~1.5-3h depending on shard. Logs: https://deploy/logs/job-1751234567

Aisha: quick q — how are we gating locks? full-table lock risk? :thinking_face:

Sam: no full-table locks. DDL is non-blocking CTAS + swap. We use shadow index + atomic rename to avoid long locks. Backfill streams use throttled workers.

Nora: what's the quiesce signal command? global or per-region?

Sam: per-region. Sequence: quiesce eu -> validate -> quiesce us-west -> validate -> quiesce us-east. Command for ops:

```
# quiesce region (example)
redwoodctl quiesce --region eu --flag tenant_swap.quiesce --timeout 10m
```

Tim: add a safepoint and a manual hold after DDL success. if canary shows regressions, abort and rollback pin.

Sam: agreed. added a 30m manual holdpoint after DDL apply for canary checks. deploy-bot will open holdpoint and require `/deploybot holdpoint ack job-1751234567` to continue.

deploy-bot: holdpoint opened (window=30m). To continue: `/deploybot holdpoint ack job-1751234567`; to abort: `/deploybot abort job-1751234567`

mig-ops: backfill rate: start at 5r/s per worker, auto-scale to 20r/s if CPU <60% and latency <200ms. fallback: reduce to 1r/s and short-circuit to partial idx if saturation.

Nora: rollback plan spelled out? need rollback doc link in release notes.

Sam: rollback steps:
- abort backfill + drain workers
- revert api pin to v2.8.0
- restore pre-change routing on canary hosts
- revert rename swap (rename back indexes) if DDL partially applied
- run row-fix script for inconsistent rows

Rollback playbook: https://confluence/rh/mig-rollback-playbook

Aisha: what are our abort triggers? (soops: SLO breach, lock >1m, error rate >2%)

Tim: capture metrics: pg_locks, apply latency, backfill error-rate, tail-latency 95/99. If error-rate >2% for 10m during canary -> abort.

Sam: noted. adding alert rules to release channel and deploy-bot will post health heartbeat every 2m.

deploy-bot: health-heartbeat enabled for job-1751234567 -> posting updates to #eng-releases.

mig-ops: heads-up — we'll run a small dry-run against a shadow shard at 01:15 UTC to validate rename script. If that passes, proceed with main window.

Nora: can someone own release notes? I'll add the rollback bullets but need the final pin/version text.

Sam: I'll add the version pin and change-window notes in release notes. TL;DR: service pinned to v2.8.1 during window, auto-unpin after backfill and validation.

Tim: please tag customer success for any customers on the older schema toggle.

Aisha: acked. I'll watch the eu quiesce and canary checks.

Sam: thanks all — will post live updates here. :rocket: 

deploy-bot: job-1751234567 — DDL apply started at 1751234590

Sam: DDL apply hit a transient index-rename contention on a secondary pod, mitigation: paused index swap, retried with backoff.

Aisha: seeing spike in lock_waits on replica-3, watching.

deploy-bot: DDL apply completed. opening manual holdpoint for canary validation (30m). Canaries: 5% traffic eu only.

Nora: canary metrics look good so far (error-rate 0.1%, p99 latency +3ms). :thumbsup: 

Tim: still watch row-consistency checks, run consistency query on sample set after 10m.

Sam: continuing to quiesce other regions in sequence. Will call for unpin after backfill completes and sanity checks are green.

deploy-bot: backfill started at 1751235020 (rate=5r/s -> autoscale)

mig-ops: backfill scaling up to 12r/s, cpu healthy, tail latency stable.

Sam: if anything crosses abort triggers, hit `/deploybot abort job-1751234567` and ping me + @Tim immediately.

Nora: noted. adding a small note in release notes: "If abort occurs, follow rollback playbook and notify ops on-call."

Aisha: watching EU -> proceeding to US-west in 10m.

Sam: thanks — waving off. will post summary when complete. :white_check_mark:
